facts.text: The Bachelor of Fine Arts in Interior Design is a 132-unit program accredited by the Council for Interior Design Accreditation (CIDA) that incorporates a third-year professional externship.

sources.title: BFA in Interior Design Curriculum Overview | Design Institute of San Diego
sources.quote: The curriculum at Design Institute of San Diego leads to the Bachelor of Fine Arts in Interior Design degree, which is accredited by the Council for Interior Design Accreditation (CIDA).
